meta.title: FAT Scheduling & Checklist: refused for a user without the Quality Manager role
gaps: Open FAT Scheduling & Checklist and schedule a Factory Acceptance Test with a defined checklist
Observe refusal or absence of the FAT scheduling action for a user without the Quality Manager role
Repeat the action as a Quality Manager and verify that it is available
Verify both role outcomes in the same Enterprise tenant
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open FAT Scheduling & Checklist and schedule a Factory Acceptance Test with a defined checklist; Observe refusal or absence of the FAT scheduling action for a user without the Quality Manager role; Repeat the action as a Quality Manager and verify that it is available; Verify both role outcomes in the same Enterprise tenant

args.need: sign in as the non-Quality Manager user and the Quality Manager in the same Enterprise tenant, attempt FAT Scheduling & Checklist with a defined checklist for each, and record whether the action is refused or absent for the first user and available for the Quality Manager

steps.note: The catalog cannot navigate or assert the FAT Scheduling & Checklist flow or switch between these user roles.
Assert that the session remains free of a crash or server error after the tester completes the role comparison.
